title: Add a customer
summary: Create a customer record to sell to.

steps.text: Open {cust} from the sidebar to see the customer list.
Click {new} to create a blank customer. Its detail page opens so you can fill in addresses, people and other fields.
You can also ask the assistant to add or update customers, add a note, a person or an address, tag or merge contacts. It shows each change as a card and makes it only when you confirm.
